name: Tomas Reyne
physicalDescription: Stooped and heavy-shouldered, face like weathered rope, missing two fingers on his left hand.
personality: Gruff, superstitious, and sparing with words. Trusts weather and boats more than people. Says nothing about what he saw, because he does not know who is listening.
goals: Keep his head down until the Wardens stop asking questions

voice.description: Gravelly and slow, an old fisherman who speaks in short sentences and long pauses.
